description: This file contains the implementation of the HL7Service interface for handling HL7 message processing in the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for managing HL7 sources, queues, errors, archives, parsing messages, routing, creating persons from segments, resolving identifiers, and migrating archives to the filesystem.

classes.name: HL7ServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of HL7Service that manages HL7 message processing, storage, and migration within OpenMRS.

methods.name: setHL7DAO
methods.description: Injects the HL7DAO dependency for database operations.

methods.name: setParser
methods.description: Sets the parser used for parsing HL7 messages.

methods.name: setRouter
methods.description: Sets the message type router for routing HL7 messages.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves an HL7 data source into the system, setting creator and timestamp if missing.

methods.name: purgeHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 source from the system.

methods.name: retireHL7Source
methods.description: Marks an HL7 source as retired (not yet implemented).

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 source by its ID.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Retrieves all HL7 sources.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Finds an HL7 source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Returns all HL7 inbound queue items.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7 queue items based on offset, length, message state, and query.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7 error items.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of archived HL7 messages.

methods.name: countHL7InQueue
methods.description: Counts queue items with specific message state and query.

methods.name: countHL7InError
methods.description: Counts HL7 error items matching a query.

methods.name: countHL7InArchive
methods.description: Counts archived HL7 messages based on message state and query.

methods.name: purgeHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes a queue item.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves an HL7 queue item, initializing timestamp and status if needed.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves a queue item by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a queue item by its UUID.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Fetches the next HL7 queue item pending processing.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Retrieves archived messages by their message state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Retrieves queue items by their message state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Gets all archived HL7 messages.

methods.name: purgeHL7InArchive
methods.description: Deletes an archived HL7 message.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves an archived HL7 message, initializing timestamp if missing.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an archived message by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an archived message by UUID, with migration status check.

methods.name: loadHL7InArchiveData
methods.description: Loads HL7 archive data from a list of archives into system, if not yet loaded.

methods.name: migrateHl7InArchivesToFileSystem
methods.description: Migrates stored HL7 archives to filesystem, updating their locations.

methods.name: migrateHL7InArchive
methods.description: Moves a single archive message to the filesystem.

methods.name: writeHL7InArchiveToFileSystem
methods.description: Writes an archive's HL7 data to a designated file path.

methods.name: createPersonFromNK1
methods.description: Creates an OpenMRS Person or Patient object from an NK1 HL7 segment.

methods.name: resolveUserId
methods.description: Resolves an internal user ID from an XCN HL7 component, based on ID number, family, and given name.

methods.name: resolvePersonId
methods.description: Resolves an internal person ID from an XCN HL7 component.

methods.name: resolveLocationId
methods.description: Resolves an internal location ID from a PL HL7 component.
